$comment: Image placeholders on text-only routes. A route that can only send text writes one placeholder line per attached image, byte-identical on every end, and its outgoing request body carries no image block. Each end runs one test per case, named IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_<id> (Web: it('IMAGE-PLACEHOLDER-<id> ...')), and asserts both the route declaration and the body produced by its production request builder for that route.
